messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> canary rollout for release 2026.03.17-rc3. Change window 21:00-23:00 UTC. Canary traffic 10%. Watch SLOs: https://dash.redwood/slo/canary :rocket:
maria: starting preflight smoke checks now. pulling p95/p99, 5xx, kv-cache metrics. pinning model variant v3.2-quant for this rollout so we don't get auto-variant swaps.
jon: confirmed pin. rollout plan: 10% -> 50% after 10m -> 100% after stable for 30m. manual rollback gating on >0.5% 5xx or p95 >250ms sustained 5m.
devon: quick snapshot: p95=180ms (baseline 170), p99=420ms, 5xx=0.6% (SLO 0.5%). KV cache miss rate +12% on canary vs baseline. link: https://dash.redwood/graphs/xyz
lia: logs show repeated backend timeout to embedder pool: `grpc deadline exceeded` on node canary-3. stack: `embedder->model-proxy->kv-store`
kevin: hmm, likely cold-starts due to quantized kernel warmup. nodes showing higher GPU mem churn. pausing traffic ramp until we confirm origin.
maria: running smoke script now -> `/opt/deploy/smoke_checks.sh --canary canary-3 --quick`
deploy-bot: smoke_checks output:
```
SMOKE START: 21:07:13 UTC
gen_test_100x: 98/100 success
latency_mean: 165ms
p95: 185ms
errors: 3 total (2 grpc deadline exceeded -> embedder)
KV_CACHE_MISS: 11.8% (baseline 0.9%)
SMOKE END: 21:08:01 UTC
```
jon: KV cache miss jumping that much is a red flag. if embedder pool is misrouted or cache keys differ this will regress quality & cost.
kevin: propose: pause ramp, revert canary nodes to previous runtime image (keep model pined) and investigate embedder routing. rollback command ready: `/deploy rollback --canary canary-3 --to-image=2026.03.09-runtime`
maria: +1. I'm going to tag eng-runtime and eng-ml for root cause. filing quick incident note in #incidents after rollback.
jon: decision: abort canary for 2026.03.17-rc3. rollback now to restore SLOs. we'll re-run with a warmed embedder pool and KV warmup in the next window.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @jon: `/deploy rollback --canary canary-3 --to-image=2026.03.09-runtime`
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary traffic back to baseline. Confirmed p95=172ms, 5xx=0.12% on baseline after rollback. :white_check_mark:
maria: creating release note update: "canary aborted due to embedder latency and KV miss spikes; rollback executed; investigating embedder routing and warmup procedures." tagging: @eng-sre @eng-runtime @eng-ml :eyes:
jon: follow-up actions: 1) add KV warmup hook to canary start 2) add embedder routing smoke to preflight 3) add alert that fires at 0.3% 5xx during rollouts.
kevin: I'll own action 1 & 2. devon, can you add the alert rule and a dashboard panel for rollout deltas?
devon: yup will add and ping when live.
lia: saving logs + stack traces to the incident thread. will attach core snippets for postmortem.
maria: thanks team. leaving notes in the release changelog and scheduling a retest in next change window. :thumbsup:
